cross_field_invariants: DRY_RUN => result.outcome IN {DRY_RUN_SUCCESS,ABORT_NO_MUTATION} AND mutation_performed=false AND transaction_commit=NOT_ATTEMPTED
DRY_RUN => observation_consistency=POINT_IN_TIME_NON_COMMIT_AUTHORITY AND snapshot_precondition=NOT_CHECKED_NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_DRY_RUN AND every steps.*=NOT_APPLICABLE
result.error.value=null <=> result.error.source=null
result.error.value matches ERROR regex <=> result.error.source IN {DRY_RUN,TRANSACTION,POST_CHECK_COMPLIANCE,POST_CHECK_CHECK_ERROR,LOCK_RELEASE}
DRY_RUN_SUCCESS => operation_mode=DRY_RUN AND result.error.source=null AND result.error.value=null
NOOP_SUCCESS => operation_mode=APPLY AND exact_target_set=[] AND mutation_performed=false AND transaction_commit=NOT_ATTEMPTED

NOOP_SUCCESS => observation_consistency=POINT_IN_TIME_NON_COMMIT_AUTHORITY AND snapshot_precondition=NOT_CHECKED_NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_NOOP AND every steps.*=NOT_APPLICABLE AND result.error.source=null AND result.error.value=null
APPLY AND result.outcome!=NOOP_SUCCESS => observation_consistency=NOT_APPLICABLE
APPLY AND result.outcome!=NOOP_SUCCESS => snapshot_precondition IN {PASS,FAILED,NOT_REACHED}
APPLY AND result.outcome!=NOOP_SUCCESS => no steps.* may be NOT_APPLICABLE
snapshot_precondition IN {FAILED,NOT_REACHED} => result.outcome=ABORT_NO_MUTATION AND every steps.*=NOT_REACHED
operation_mode=APPLY AND steps.lock_acquire IN {OK,FAILED} => snapshot_precondition=PASS
operation_mode=APPLY AND steps.lock_acquire=OK => steps.lock_release IN {OK,FAILED} on every reportable terminal path
operation_mode=APPLY AND steps.lock_acquire IN {FAILED,NOT_REACHED} => steps.lock_release=NOT_REACHED
APPLY ordered steps are monotone: after the first FAILED or NOT_REACHED, every later ordered step is NOT_REACHED; lock_release is governed separately
steps.temp_content_verification=FAILED => result.outcome=ABORT_NO_MUTATION AND mutation_performed=false AND transaction_commit=NOT_ATTEMPTED
steps.rename=NOT_REACHED => result.outcome=ABORT_NO_MUTATION AND mutation_performed=false AND transaction_commit=NOT_ATTEMPTED
steps.rename=FAILED => result.outcome=ABORT_NO_MUTATION AND mutation_performed=false AND transaction_commit=NOT_COMMITTED AND steps.parent_dir_fsync=NOT_REACHED AND steps.post_check=NOT_REACHED
steps.rename=OK => mutation_performed=true AND exact_target_set is a non-empty array AND steps.parent_dir_fsync IN {OK,FAILED}

steps.parent_dir_fsync=FAILED => transaction_commit=COMMITTED_DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN AND steps.post_check=NOT_REACHED AND result.outcome=COMMITTED_DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN AND result.error.source=TRANSACTION AND result.error.value matches ERROR regex
steps.parent_dir_fsync=OK => transaction_commit=COMMITTED AND steps.post_check IN {OK,FAILED}
steps.post_check=OK => steps.parent_dir_fsync=OK

steps.post_check=FAILED => steps.parent_dir_fsync=OK AND transaction_commit=COMMITTED AND result.outcome=COMMITTED_FAILURE AND result.error.source IN {POST_CHECK_COMPLIANCE,POST_CHECK_CHECK_ERROR} AND result.error.value matches ERROR regex
result.error.source=POST_CHECK_COMPLIANCE => steps.post_check=FAILED AND result.error.value=post-check:compliance-fail
result.error.value=post-check:compliance-fail => result.error.source=POST_CHECK_COMPLIANCE AND steps.post_check=FAILED
result.error.source=POST_CHECK_CHECK_ERROR => steps.post_check=FAILED AND result.error.value equals the exact CHECK domain:reason unchanged
steps.post_check IN {OK,NOT_REACHED,NOT_APPLICABLE} => result.error.source NOT IN {POST_CHECK_COMPLIANCE,POST_CHECK_CHECK_ERROR}
COMMITTED_SUCCESS => operation_mode=APPLY AND snapshot_precondition=PASS AND every steps.*=OK AND transaction_commit=COMMITTED AND result.error.source=null AND result.error.value=null

COMMITTED_FAILURE => operation_mode=APPLY AND snapshot_precondition=PASS AND ordered steps through parent_dir_fsync=OK AND transaction_commit=COMMITTED AND ((steps.post_check=FAILED AND steps.lock_release IN {OK,FAILED} AND result.error.source IN {POST_CHECK_COMPLIANCE,POST_CHECK_CHECK_ERROR}) OR (steps.post_check=OK AND steps.lock_release=FAILED AND result.error.source=LOCK_RELEASE)) AND result.error.value matches ERROR regex

COMMITTED_DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN => operation_mode=APPLY AND snapshot_precondition=PASS AND ordered steps through rename=OK AND steps.parent_dir_fsync=FAILED AND steps.post_check=NOT_REACHED AND steps.lock_release IN {OK,FAILED} AND result.error.source=TRANSACTION AND result.error.value matches ERROR regex
ABORT_NO_MUTATION AND operation_mode=DRY_RUN => mutation_performed=false AND transaction_commit=NOT_ATTEMPTED AND result.error.source=DRY_RUN AND result.error.value matches ERROR regex

ABORT_NO_MUTATION AND operation_mode=APPLY => mutation_performed=false AND transaction_commit IN {NOT_ATTEMPTED,NOT_COMMITTED} AND result.error.source=TRANSACTION AND result.error.value matches ERROR regex
COMMITTED_FAILURE AND steps.post_check=OK => steps.lock_release=FAILED AND result.error.source=LOCK_RELEASE
result.error.source=LOCK_RELEASE => steps.lock_release=FAILED AND steps.post_check=OK
prestate_sha256 null member OR exact_target_set=null => result.outcome=ABORT_NO_MUTATION AND result.error.source is non-null AND result.error.value is non-null
